standard_prerequisites.name: The vanishing of local cohomology above the dimension of the support, and the bound cd(A, I) \leq dim(A) for a finitely generated ideal
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Author lemma lemma-cd-dimension, whose statement is reproduced verbatim as a context span of this card (source lines 758-764)
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies both the vanishing on the quotient by f and the bound that produces the second surjection.

standard_prerequisites.name: The exact sequence relating the local cohomology of a module, of its image under multiplication by an element and of the quotient
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Used inside the counted proof at source lines 3640-3645
standard_prerequisites.use: Turns the vanishing on the quotient into the required surjectivity.

core_obligations: Kill the quotient: the support of the quotient of the module by an element f outside the minimal primes of maximal dimension has dimension strictly below d, so its top local cohomology vanishes by the context lemma (proof lines 3640-3641)

First surjectivity: the long exact sequence of the short exact sequence defined by multiplication by f then shows that the map on top local cohomology from the image of f to the module is surjective (proof line 3642)

Second surjectivity: the bound cd(A, I) \leq d supplied by the context lemma shows that multiplication by f on the module induces a surjection on top local cohomology in the opposite direction as well (proof lines 3643-3645)
Conclusion: composing the two surjections displays multiplication by f itself as surjective on the top local cohomology (proof lines 3645-3646)
proof_roadmap: 由 f 不在任何 d 维极小素中，Supp(M/fM) 的维数 < d，故由 lemma-cd-dimension 得 H^d_{V(I)}(M/fM) = 0；长正合列给出 H^d_{V(I)}(fM) → H^d_{V(I)}(M) 满。
再由 lemma-cd-dimension 的空维数上界 cd(A,I) ≤ d，M → fM 在 H^d 上也诱导满射；两段满射复合即得 f 在 H^d_{V(I)}(M) 上满。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that on a Noetherian local ring of dimension d, multiplication by an element not contained in any minimal prime of dimension d is surjective on the top local cohomology of every finite module, whatever the ideal and whatever the local cohomological dimension of that ideal (author lemma at source lines 3631-3637, label lemma-top-coh-divisible). The proof (source lines 3639-3646) is a support-and-dimension argument: the quotient by f has support of dimension below d so its top local cohomology vanishes, which gives one surjection from the long exact sequence, while the bound cd(A, I) \leq d gives the surjection in the other direction. H2.
